en: A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a wide view of Piazza del Duomo in Trento, Italy. In the center stands a large baroque fountain with multiple statues, surrounded by historic multi-story buildings with arcades and shuttered windows. A domed church or cathedral rises on the right side of the square. Printed captions appear at the top: on the left, a slogan, and on the right, the city and square name.
